description: This is a Dart source file implementing a rules engine for the classic Ludo game. It defines an abstract final class 'LudoRulesEngine' with static methods to compute legal moves, apply moves, end turns, and handle game logic such as capturing pieces, reaching the home stretch, and determining game over conditions.

classes.name: LudoRulesEngine
classes.description: An abstract class providing static methods to determine legal moves, apply moves, and manage game state transitions in a classic Ludo game.

methods.name: legalMoves
methods.description: Computes all legal moves for the current player given a dice roll.

methods.name: applyMove
methods.description: Applies a move to the game state, returning an updated immutable game state, including handling captures, winning, and extra turns.

methods.name: endTurnIfNeeded
methods.description: Advances the turn to the next player if no extra roll is available.
